detail:
Full summary: Plugin 1.13.0: bundled server now spawns via sh -lc login shell, fixing minimal-PATH teams/GUI sessions for all POSIX users with zero per-repo config. Repo drops its .mcp.json pin + deny + mcp-deny-sync CI job. SessionStart hook detection updated to mirror the login-shell resolution. Windows fallback documented.
Decisions: Switched the plugin's bundled server to the sh -lc login-shell wrapper (Dave approved via explicit trade-off question) — supersedes the 07-09 decision to keep bare npx and only warn via SessionStart hook. What changed since: env-expansion facts were rechecked (no platform conditionals exist, so there is genuinely no both-platforms option), the per-repo workaround demonstrated ongoing field cost (brittle exact-command deny needing a CI job to police), and zero Windows plugin users have materialized. The burden inverts to the hypothetical Windows user: documented one-line project .mcp.json with bare npx, no deny needed since their sh server never spawns.; Updated the SessionStart hook's availability probe to sh -lc 'command -v npx' to mirror the new spawn method exactly — the old bare probe would false-positive (warn + suppress gates) in precisely the minimal-PATH sessions the wrapper now fixes.; Removed this repo's .mcp.json, deniedMcpServers block, and the mcp-deny-sync CI job+script within hours of adding the latter — the structural fix (plugin-side wrapper) obsoletes the lockstep invariant entirely; recorded rather than silently dropped. This repo now dogfoods the plugin's bundled server path that all plugin users get.; Chose asking Dave the Windows trade-off explicitly (AskUserQuestion) rather than deciding unilaterally — reversing a high-confidence decision on user-facing platform support is a product bet, not an implementation detail.
Findings: warning: local plugin cache is still 1.11.3 — update the twining plugin BEFORE the next session. With repo .mcp.json deleted and the deny removed, a stale plugin spawns twining-mcp@^1.20.0 (1.24.1), which goes READ-ONLY against this repo's now version-2 config (hooks fail open, so nothing blocks, but twining writes are unavailable until the plugin updates).; Upstream facts rechecked 2026-07-20 via docs: env expansion incl. ${VAR:-default} and ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} now WORKS in plugin .mcp.json (claude-code#9427 apparently fixed); still NO platform-conditional server definitions and NO PATH augmentation on MCP spawn. If platform conditionals ever ship, the Windows regression can be undone properly.
summary: Plugin 1.13.0: bundled server now spawns via sh -lc login shell, fixing minimal-PATH teams/GUI sessions for all POSIX users with zero per-repo config. Repo drops its .mcp.json pin + deny + mcp-deny…
